exposure: Timing of Prostin E2 administration (8th hour, 12th hour, or 24th hour) after 8 hours of Propess use for labor induction
cohort: The cohort consisted of 63 patients with an unfavorable cervix (Bishop score <= 6) after 8 hours of Propess use for labor induction.
finding: Administering Prostin E2 at the 8th hour after Propess initiation to patients with a poor response could result in a shorter induction-to-birth interval and higher Bishop scores after 24 hours.
mod_finding: No significant differences were found in the mode of birth among the different Prostin E2 administration timings.
